# 闭包内的判断与公理相合之处：以整体为界的意义就是公理；另一条路径接纳的每个形成都在区域之内或被第一条接纳之处，以区域为界的判断就是公理的判断，所以供给闭包是整体时总是；在清除者的网中两者分开 / Where the verdict within the closure meets the axiom: significance bounded by the whole is the axiom; wherever every formation the other path admits lies in the region or is admitted by the first, the verdict bounded by the region is the axiom's, and so always where the feeding closure is the whole; in the clearer's web the two part

## 主张 Claim

以整体为界的意义（各立场的区域都是整体）就是公理 Unrestricted（bounded_whole）。设区域族 region、立场 p 与水平路径 l、l'，并设 l' 在每一步接纳的每个形成都在 p 的区域之内、或被 l 在该步接纳（covers）。则以区域为界的意义从 p 保留 l' 上的有意义者，恰当 l 包含 l'（Web.retains_bounded_iff_includes）；公理之下，这又恰当 l 从 p 保留 l' 上的有意义者（Web.retains_bounded_iff_retains），即两个判断一致。一个形成 p 的供给闭包是整体时，覆盖条件总成立，所以公理之下，以供给闭包为界的判断在每个比较上都是公理的判断（Flow.within_closure_iff_retains）；Overshoot 中从任一立场都是这样（Overshoot.within_closure_iff_retains）。在 Clearing 中两者分开：设 l 是扣留清除者的部分后的水平（Flow.WithheldLevels）；以供给闭包为界，从清除者的立场，有其部分的水平保留 l 上的有意义者；公理之下，从每个立场都不保留；从栖居者的立场、在栖居者自己的闭包内，l 增加有其部分的水平所缺的（Clearing.within_closure_yet_loses）。不用 Lean 公理；公理只作为比较定理的假设出现。 / Significance bounded by the whole (each standpoint's region the whole) is the axiom Unrestricted (bounded_whole). Given regions region, a standpoint p and level paths l and l', suppose every formation l' admits at a step lies in p's region or is admitted by l at that step (covers). Then significance bounded by the regions retains from p what has significance along l' exactly when l includes l' (Web.retains_bounded_iff_includes); under the axiom this is exactly when l retains from p what has significance along l' (Web.retains_bounded_iff_retains), so the two verdicts agree. Where a formation p's feeding closure is the whole, the covering condition always holds, so under the axiom the verdict bounded by the feeding closure is the axiom's on every comparison (Flow.within_closure_iff_retains); in Overshoot this holds from either standpoint (Overshoot.within_closure_iff_retains). In Clearing the two part: let l be the levels with the clearer's part withheld (Flow.WithheldLevels); bounded by the feeding closure, from the clearer's standpoint the levels with its part retain what has significance along l; under the axiom they do not, from any standpoint; and from the dweller's standpoint, within the dweller's own closure, l adds what the levels with the part lack (Clearing.within_closure_yet_loses). No Lean axiom is used; the axiom appears only as a hypothesis of the comparison theorems.

Canonical source: [Interdependence.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Interdependence.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 公理：Unrestricted sig，即从每个立场，任何东西在每一步的延续都有意义（对指标 (p, t, f) 的边界中立）。它是比较定理的假设，不被证明；把它读作 Ren 的公理是 AI 的读法，待 Ren。 / The axiom: Unrestricted sig, that from every standpoint the continuation of anything has significance at every step (boundary neutrality over the index (p, t, f)). It is a hypothesis of the comparison theorems and is not proved; reading it as Ren's axiom is the AI's reading, pending Ren.
- 覆盖条件（covers）：另一条路径接纳的每个形成都在区域之内或被第一条接纳；供给闭包是整体时它总成立。 / The covering condition (covers): every formation the other path admits lies in the region or is admitted by the first; it always holds where the feeding closure is the whole.
- Clearing 的比较用扣留清除者的部分后的水平（Flow.WithheldLevels），固定交换的其余部分。 / The Clearing comparison uses the levels with the clearer's part withheld (Flow.WithheldLevels), keeping the rest of the exchange fixed.
- 离散的步（从第 0 步计）；自然数的水平、所需与数量。 / Discrete steps, counted from step 0; natural-number levels, needs and amounts.

路线 (b) 是 AI 的表述，Ren 引用了它：“No axiom. The theory only describes, and “should” is what a center does once its represented boundary matches what it actually depends on. The theory then explains recognition and motivation but claims no warrant beyond them.” Ren 选定：“let's aim for a first, then try to archive b”。作者的读法（AI 论证，待 Ren）：供给闭包读“what it actually depends on”。P40 也把它读作 Ren 的“the system that one is in”，作为从一个中心沿依存到达的系统；这一读法由 P42 撤回：供给闭包在影响闭包之内，影响闭包与所及闭包都在系统之内，为那一层级提供的是所及闭包（见 levels-of-closure，AI 的读法，待 Ren）。名称（FedClosed、WithinFeeding、Overshoot 等）是 AI 按 Ren 的命名准则所选。Ren 对层级写道：“i think it should be the whole, and a weaker version is within the system that one is in, then the self”；又写道：“there could be the whole realizes itself(like us, we recognize that "we" are the universe/ecosystem that realizes its own existence), understanding itself, and updates itself, this is also under the selection rules and constraints in theory, but in practice, how this happens, needs more thoughts”。作者的读法（AI 论证，待 Ren）：路线 (b) 到达自身及其所依存的（P42 更正：原写“自身与所在的系统”），只在整体是一个供给闭包时到达整体，那时它的判断就是公理的判断；公理所加的，是那些损失返回不到任何人的延续的意义；以整体为所表示边界的中心，持有的就是公理的意义（bounded_whole）。 / Route (b) is the AI's wording, which Ren quoted: “No axiom. The theory only describes, and “should” is what a center does once its represented boundary matches what it actually depends on. The theory then explains recognition and motivation but claims no warrant beyond them.” Ren chose: “let's aim for a first, then try to archive b”. The author's reading (an AI argument, pending Ren): the feeding closure reads “what it actually depends on”. P40 also read it as Ren's “the system that one is in”, the system reached from a center along dependence; P42 withdraws that reading: the feeding closure lies within the influence closure, the influence and reach closures lie within the system, and the reach closure is offered for that level (see levels-of-closure; the AI's reading, pending Ren). The names (FedClosed, WithinFeeding, Overshoot and others) are the AI's, chosen by Ren's naming standard. Of the levels Ren wrote: “i think it should be the whole, and a weaker version is within the system that one is in, then the self”; and: “there could be the whole realizes itself(like us, we recognize that "we" are the universe/ecosystem that realizes its own existence), understanding itself, and updates itself, this is also under the selection rules and constraints in theory, but in practice, how this happens, needs more thoughts”. The author's reading (an AI argument, pending Ren): route (b) reaches the self and what it depends on (P42 correction: it said “the self and the system one is in”), and the whole only where the whole is one feeding closure, where its verdict is the axiom's; what the axiom adds is significance for continuations whose loss returns to no one; a center whose represented boundary is the whole holds the axiom's significance (bounded_whole).

公理只作为比较的假设出现，不被证明；覆盖条件是充分条件，不是必要条件；只比较被接纳的形成，每一步；以扣留水平的比较固定交换的其余部分；路线 (b) 不主张根据；整体之间的选择没有建模；“中心以整体为所表示的边界”是读法，不模型中心怎样表示；读法与名称是 AI 的，待 Ren；G0 由第二部分的公理推出，Ren 2026-10-11 把它折叠，它不再是公理（P51）。 / The axiom appears only as a hypothesis of the comparisons and is not proved; the covering condition is sufficient, not necessary; only formations admitted are compared, step by step; comparisons by withheld levels keep the rest of the exchange fixed; route (b) claims no warrant; selection between wholes is not modelled; “a center whose represented boundary is the whole” is a reading, and how a center represents is not modelled; the readings and names are the AI's, pending Ren; G0 follows from Part II's axiom, and since Ren folded it on 11 October 2026 it is no longer an axiom (P51).
